name: Anthony Howard Jr.
strengths: Howard hits the designed hole on one cut and gets north-south without dancing behind the line.
Howard finishes runs with enough thump at 195 to move the pile and fall forward through arm tackles.
Howard shows a clear second gear once he clears the second level and stretches the defense outside.
weaknesses: Howard still needs to prove every-down pass-protection consistency versus SEC edge pressure.
comparison: Howard comps to Rachaad White — 5-10 / 5-11 mold with between-tackle thump and enough juice to finish outside once he clears the second level.
projection: Howard projects as a Year 2 SEC starter at RB (package / special teams Year 1). Ceiling: every-down SEC feature back — the one-cut runner who can thump inside and still stress the edge.
schemeFit: Howard fits a one-cut zone/gap RB room that values north-south vision and enough mass to finish between the tackles.
insiderNotes: Howard is a compact 5-10 / 195 IMG back who hits the hole on one cut, finishes with thump, and still shows a second gear outside. Wins with vision and contact balance — a feature-back mold from the Auburndale / IMG pipeline.
staffNotes: Vault film desk drafted 2026-08-06 from On3/Hudl + board bio. Comp size-matched within ~1–2" — not a Florida-alum default.
recruitingStory: Anthony Howard Jr. is a 3 RB · listed 5-10.5 / 195 · IMG Academy (Auburndale, FL) · open-board Florida target.
angle: Lead with IMG one-cut vision + 195-pound finish; Florida in-state RB chase.
